name: Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. Sit down with both legs extended . This will be your starting position.
Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other leg.
prompt: This is a Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the hamstrings. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. Sit down with both legs extended . This will be your starting position. Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other leg."
